info.title: Courtside – Youth Basketball API
info.description:
Admin panel + mobile app API.

**Login:** `POST /user/login` sends an OTP, `POST /user/verify-otp` returns a token. Click **Authorize** and paste the token (without `Bearer`) to call protected routes.

delete.description:
**Access:** Super admin only

```
Default: club ARCHIVE hota hai (isArchived: true), data bacha rehta hai, uske club admins / coaches /
parents login nahi kar paate. Wapas laane ke liye PUT /api/user/restoreClub/:id.
Permanent delete: DELETE /api/user/deleteClub/:id?permanent=true
Permanent delete mein club ke saath:
1. Club admins aur Coaches ke User accounts delete hote hain (user table)
2. ClubAdmin, Coach aur Team records delete hote hain
3. Club ka logo S3 se delete hota hai (purana local file ho toh disk se)
4. Club document delete hota hai (club table)
```

get.description:
**Access:** Super admin or club admin

```
&teamId=&coachId=&facilityId=&status=&clubId=(sirf superAdmin)&sent=true
  (superAdmin ya clubAdmin) draft + published + cancelled, aur unsentCount.
from / to na do toh is hafte (Sun-Sat). type: training | game | home_game | away_game | other, comma se kai.
Repeat wala schedule range ki har date par ek entry deta hai (same _id, alag date).
page / limit do toh 10-10 ki pagination (repeat ki har date ek entry), na do toh range ki saari entries (calendar).
unsentIds = draft + bhejne ke baad badle schedules ("Send schedule" button ke liye).
```

**Access:** Super admin or club admin

Badlav poore schedule (saari dates) par lagta hai.
Published schedule badle toh hasUnsentChanges = true, "Send schedule" tak.
```

Season registration bill banana: ek player = ek bill (items: season fee, jersey...).
Do tarah se:
  feePlanId do  -> season / title / dueDate Fee Plan se. Har player ki fee uski team ke age group (category) se:
                   subscription + jersey. teamId / playerIds na do toh club ke saare players.
                   Jiski fee nahi (team nahi, ya us group ki fee 0) wo skip ("noFee").
  items do      -> haath se price, sabke liye same (purana tareeka). teamId ya playerIds zaroori.
teamId do toh poori team, playerIds do toh sirf wo. Jis player ka same plan (ya same season + title) ka bill pehle se hai, wo skip.
overrides: kisi player ki alag fee, [{ playerId, items: [{ type, name, amount }] }]. Baaki sab ko normal price.
Plan ka proRate on: season (Aug-Jul) ke beech join kiya toh bache mahino ki fee. Join date = joinDate ya player ki registration date.
body: { clubId?, feePlanId?, season?, title?, teamId?, playerIds?, items?: [{ type, name, amount }], overrides?, dueDate?, currency?, joinDate? }
```
